scope: cross-fitted test files of corrected, deduplicated SMASH Xe+Cs 2.87 GeV/nucleon (U_sym 0/18/90 MeV), split 848ebf49; each file scored only by models that never saw it; the files were scored by the frozen transfer before, so not a blind holdout

definitions.auc/ap: ROC-AUC and average precision of cl_score against the native label, per fold, then averaged over folds per seed (reconstructed score, MC-truth label)
definitions.purity/efficiency: at the cut frozen on fold validation (count purity 0.70)
definitions.bias/mae: mean and mean absolute e_pred - e_true over all MC-positive clusters, GeV (MC-truth label and energy, reconstructed energy)

delta_bias_window.note: seed SE excludes the file-sampling error shared by all seeds; compare against the per-arm boot SDs
